chain: K_strict -> coefficients -> full explicit L_total -> metric attack plan -> first explicit E_munu candidate

attack_plan_anchor.goal: Produce first metric-sector EL residual-zero certificate in nonproxy-like convention.

inputs.metric_template: E_{μν} := (M_Pl^2/2)G_{μν} + Λ g_{μν} + H_{μν}[c1 R^2 + c2 R_{αβ}R^{αβ} + c3 R_{αβγδ}R^{αβγδ}] - T^{(gauge+higgs+fermion+scalar+mix)}_{μν} = 0

full_lagrangian_anchor.L_fermion: sqrt(-g)*[Σ_f i ψ̄_f γ^a e_a^{ μ}D_μ ψ_f - Σ_f y_f(ψ̄_{fL}Hψ_{fR}+h.c.)]
full_lagrangian_anchor.L_gravity: sqrt(-g)*[(M_Pl^2/2)R - Λ + c1 R^2 + c2 R_{μν}R^{μν} + c3 R_{μναβ}R^{μναβ}]

attack_plan_anchor.success_condition: EL_g(L_total) - E_munu == 0 in declared admissible class
attack_plan_anchor.failure_condition: export obstruction polynomial / unmatched tensor terms with provenance

full_lagrangian_explicit_anchor.L_fermion: sqrt(-g)*[Σ_f i ψ̄_f γ^a e_a^{ μ}D_μ ψ_f - Σ_f y_f(ψ̄_{fL}Hψ_{fR}+h.c.)]
full_lagrangian_explicit_anchor.L_gravity: sqrt(-g)*[(M_Pl^2/2)R - Λ + c1 R^2 + c2 R_{μν}R^{μν} + c3 R_{μναβ}R^{μναβ}]

metric_candidate_export.E_munu_candidate: E_{μν} := (M_Pl^2/2)G_{μν} + Λ g_{μν} + c1*H^{(R2)}_{μν} + c2*H^{(Ric2)}_{μν} + c3*H^{(Riem2)}_{μν} - T^{gauge}_{μν} - T^{higgs}_{μν} - T^{fermion}_{μν} - T^{scalar}_{μν} - T^{mix}_{μν} = 0

source_terms_from_full_lagrangian.L_gravity: sqrt(-g)*[(M_Pl^2/2)R - Λ + c1 R^2 + c2 R_{μν}R^{μν} + c3 R_{μναβ}R^{μναβ}]
source_terms_from_full_lagrangian.L_fermion: sqrt(-g)*[Σ_f i ψ̄_f γ^a e_a^{ μ}D_μ ψ_f - Σ_f y_f(ψ̄_{fL}Hψ_{fR}+h.c.)]

next_honest_step: Rozwinąć E_munu_candidate do jawnej postaci składnikowej H^(R2), H^(Ric2), H^(Riem2) i uruchomić test residual EL_g - E_munu w tej samej konwencji.
